title: HALO Fireteam Raven
platform: Raw Thrills Linux PC Based (64-bit ELF)

options.description_en: Native route: STEREO plays the game's own stereo mix; LPCM 5.1 sends 6-channel PCM (front, center, LFE, surround) made from the game's stereo mix by RavenGun's FMOD wrapper. Applies at the next start.

items.description_en: Persistent operator/user store of the Raw Thrills engine (adjustments, audits, highscores, gamelog.txt). Created at first run; in the RavenGun sandbox it lives in the overlay (~/.local/share/ravengun/halo-overlay/upper/pmuser).
items.erase_effect_en: Resets highscores, audits and operator adjustments to defaults. The game recreates the folder. Exit code 225 of the game itself is a factory reset.

items.description_en: Dongle data image read by the game through the HASP shim (a second copy has the 32-bit binary file id as its name). Not user data.
items.erase_effect_en: The game will not start (or runs in a degraded mode) without it. Do not erase or edit.

memory_card.notes_en: Operator adjustment definitions under data/prod/adj/*/defs are encrypted/binary in this dump and cannot be listed.
